subject: Per-million dollar targets & route mix proposal
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Sandra Huang <sandra.huang@aquiferhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-09T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Per-million dollar targets & route mix proposal

Hi Sandra — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and the next steps we discussed so we have everything aligned.

Summary of what you told us:
- Current: ~45M tokens/month (primarily inference for triage + summarization flows).
- Growth plan: ramp to ~120M tokens/month within 6 months with an expectation that peak months could be ~160M.
- Primary constraint: unit economics — target is to get to under $1,800 / 1M tokens for peak inference (average across all routes).

Our initial thinking (attached spreadsheet has line-by-line math):
- Route mix proposals (examples):
  1) Open-model route (cheap, good for low-latency short prompts): 50% of tokens at a baseline rate — suggested list rate $120 / 1M tokens.
  2) Quantized private model route (higher quality on quantized weights): 30% at $420 / 1M tokens.
  3) High-quality Redwood-verified route (larger context, heavy KV cache usage): 20% at $2,100 / 1M tokens.
- Blended example: 0.5*$120 + 0.3*$420 + 0.2*$2100 = $582 / 1M tokens (list-blend). With committed step-ups and a 20% reserved discount at 120M+, the blended goes to ~$466 / 1M.
- If your target is $1,800 / 1M, that gives significant headroom; the key levers are how much volume you route to the high-quality model and whether you want to commit to step-up volumes to secure deeper discounts.

Options we should validate next call:
- Commitment tiers: 3 levels (60M, 120M, 240M) with escalating discounts.
- Route add: add a dedicated inference route for the summarization flow (reduces per-token cost for long-context calls by ~25% once cached).
- Blended guarantee: we can structure a blend commitment with a waterfall discount schedule tied to monthly shipped tokens and route share.

Please confirm these items so we can produce a formal price worksheet:
1) FYI: Confirm expected month-to-month ramp (example in sheet).
2) Which routes you plan to prioritize (open / quantized-private / high-quality).
3) Target $/1M you want for renewal effective July 1 (is $1,800 the floor target or a maximum budget?).
4) Timeline for procurement/PO (procurement contact + typical turnaround).

Attachments: redwood-route-mix-scenarios.xlsx (scenario math), draft-mop-proposal-terms.pdf (skeleton commercial terms), aquifer-q1-usage.csv (usage sample for modeling).

Next steps: propose a 30-min follow-up on Wednesday 12–12:30 PT to walk the blended scenarios and lock the commitment tier. If that works I can have Marissa whip up formal numbers and a DocuSign-ready quote.

Thanks,
Karthik
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0112

From: Sandra Huang <sandra.huang@aquiferhealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aquifer Health Procurement <procurement@aquiferhealth.com>
Date: 2027-05-09T13:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Per-million dollar targets & route mix proposal

Thanks Karthik — appreciate the clear recap. A few clarifications below.

> Current: ~45M tokens/month (primarily inference for triage + summarization flows).
> Growth plan: ramp to ~120M tokens/month within 6 months

Those numbers look right. To be explicit: our ramp expected cadence is ~60M in June, ~90M in July, ~120M in August, then variable.

On targets: $1,800 / 1M is an upper bound for our procurement team — we'd prefer to land closer to $1,200–$1,500 / 1M if possible. The higher-quality route is used for clinician-facing summaries where we cannot compromise, but most token volume is lower-sensitivity summarization and search.

Questions:
1) Can you show a 3-tier commitment with blended examples that target $1,500 and $1,200 respectively?
2) For the dedicated inference route: what is the additional monthly fixed fee (if any) versus pure per-token?
3) Any minimum term length for the deeper discounts? Procurement typically wants 12 months but will consider 6 if we can get similar economics.

Procurement lead: procurement@aquiferhealth.com — they typically need 5–7 business days to review standard SOW + PO.

Happy to take the Wed 12–12:30 PT slot.

Best,
Sandra Huang
VP Product | Aquifer Health

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-09T14:02:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Per-million dollar targets & route mix proposal — pricing ask from Aquifer

Marissa / Ben — forwarding the ask from Sandra. Key asks to model: blended targets at $1,500 and $1,200, and explicit delta for dedicated-route fixed fee + per-token uplift. Procurement timeline ~5–7 business days.

Quick pricing notes (back-of-envelope):
- Baseline list rates we discussed: Open $120 / 1M, Quantized-Private $420 / 1M, HQ $2,100 / 1M.
- To get to $1,500 blended at their ramp profile (60/90/120/160M), we can do:
  * Commit 6 months at 120M (minimum) and offer 25% discount on Quantized-Private and 35% on HQ route; effective blended ~ $1,460 / 1M.
  * For $1,200 blended we'll need a steeper commitment: 12-month 180M avg with 35% on Quantized and 50% on HQ + reserved capacity allocation for the dedicated route (this reduces HQ per-token by ~30% in practice).

Dedicated route economics: recommend we quote a monthly fixed fee of $8,500 + per-token at a 10% premium to Quantized-Private list (but discounts apply on top for commitments). The fixed fee buys isolated GPU pools and reduces long-context costs via cache hit improvements. If procurement pushes for no fixed fee, we can present a higher per-token rate alternative.

Term length: we can flex 6 or 12 months. Deeper discounts reserved for 12-month commitments. For 6-months we should require higher monthly minimums.

Ask: Marissa — can you run concrete blended spreadsheets for the two target blends (1,200 and 1,500) given their ramp and include an option with/without the dedicated fixed-fee route? Also produce a 12-month vs 6-month comparison.

I'll slot Wed 12:00 PT with Sandra. If you can get me numbers by EOD Monday, I will include them in the call.

Thanks,
Karthik

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Sandra Huang <sandra.huang@aquiferhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Aquifer Health Procurement <procurement@aquiferhealth.com>
Date: 2027-05-11T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Follow-up: pricing scenarios and next steps (attachments + PO link)

Hi Sandra — thanks for taking the slot today. Per our discussion, attached are two PDF scenario worksheets and the XLSX with the line-by-line math. Highlights below and concrete asks to close the renewal: 

Recap of the two recommended scenarios (spreadsheet: redwood-route-mix-scenarios.xlsx tab A/B):
- Scenario A (target ~$1,500 / 1M): 6-month commitment, step-up to 120M in month 2, reserved discount band: Open - 30% discount, Quantized - 25% discount, HQ - 35% discount. Blended effective = $1,498 / 1M. No dedicated fixed fee; dedicated routing held as optional add-on.
- Scenario B (target ~$1,200 / 1M): 12-month commitment, average monthly commit 180M, reserved capacity for dedicated route, discounts: Open - 40%, Quantized - 35%, HQ - 50%. Blended effective = $1,198 / 1M. Includes dedicated route (fixed fee $8,500/mo + lower per-token).

Other items we agreed: procurement wants a standard SOW + PO review <7 business days. We will provide a clean DocuSign-ready quote for the selected scenario and a redlined SOW if needed.

Action items (owners & ETA):
- Aquifer: confirm which scenario (A or B) you want us to turn into the formal quote and confirm procurement contact for PO (Aquifer reply).
- Karthik: prepare DocuSign quote + SOW for selected scenario (will share within 24 hours after confirmation).
- Marissa: pricing workbook and signed-off internal approval for discounts (complete).
- Ben: stand by for any ETR on Dedicated route capacity scheduling.

Links/attachments: redwood-route-mix-scenarios.xlsx (detailed math), draft-mop-proposal-terms.pdf (commercial skeleton), Quote_DH-4682_ScenarioA.pdf, Quote_DH-4682_ScenarioB.pdf
DocuSign (placeholder): https://docusign.com/link/placeholder-quote-DH-4682
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/4682

If you confirm Scenario A, I will generate the DocuSign quote and target getting the PO signed by end of next week (timeline aligns with your procurement window). If you'd prefer Scenario B, we'll include the dedicated route scheduling options and get procurement engaged for a 12-month commitment.

Thanks — talk soon,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0112
